data.long_meaning: A beautiful Islamic name with deep spiritual significance. The name Misbah carries the meaning “Noble and blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Misbah usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the Blessing and Faith and Nobility nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Misbah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misbah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
